high_level_description: The image is a close-up, microscopic view of what appears to be cancer cells. The cells have an irregular, spiky appearance with numerous protrusions extending outward from their surface. The coloration is predominantly red and white, giving the cells a somewhat menacing look. The background is a blurred, reddish hue, suggesting a biological or cellular environment. The text overlay on the image reads: "New bacterial protein could make cancer cells kill themselves; study finds.
